issues.title: Golf Tables Completely Unprotected
issues.description: Migration 061 and 062 explicitly DISABLED ROW LEVEL SECURITY on all core golf tables. ANY authenticated user (even baseball coach) can see ALL rounds, shots, player profiles, and coach contact info from ALL teams.

context.vulnerability_type: Complete data breach - horizontal privilege escalation
context.attack_scenario: SELECT * FROM golf_rounds returns ALL rounds from ALL teams
context.impact: GDPR violation, competitive intelligence leak, personal information exposure
context.suggested_fix: Re-enable RLS and add team-scoped policies

issues.title: Missing Policies on 15 Golf Tables
issues.description: 15 golf tables have RLS ENABLED but NO POLICIES defined. Depending on Supabase defaults, tables are either completely inaccessible (blocks features) or completely open (data exposure).

context.affected_tables: golf_qualifiers, golf_qualifier_entries, golf_announcements, golf_coach_notes (PRIVATE!), golf_documents, etc.
context.suggested_fix: Add complete policy sets for all 15 tables with proper team scoping

issues.title: Golf Organizations Horizontal Data Access
issues.description: golf_organizations table has RLS disabled. ANY authenticated user can query all organizations across all teams, exposing organizational structure and relationships.

context.affected_data: Organization names, contact info, team relationships
context.suggested_fix: Enable RLS and add policy: users can view only their own organization via golf_coaches.organization_id or golf_players.team_id -> golf_teams.organization_id

issues.title: Golf Shots Complete Exposure
issues.description: golf_shots table has RLS disabled. ANY authenticated user can see ALL shot-by-shot data from ALL players on ALL teams, exposing complete performance patterns and competitive intelligence.

context.attack_scenario: SELECT * FROM golf_shots WHERE shot_type = 'putting' returns ALL putts from ALL players
context.competitive_impact: Opponents can analyze player weaknesses shot-by-shot
context.suggested_fix: Enable RLS and add policies: players view own shots, coaches view team shots via round ownership

issues.title: Overall RLS Security Score: 28/100
issues.description: Comprehensive RLS audit reveals 37 tables with RLS disabled or missing policies, 23 high severity permissive policies, 18 SECURITY DEFINER functions bypassing RLS. Security score: 28/100 (CRITICAL RISK).

context.security_breakdown: RLS Coverage: 10/30, Policy Quality: 5/30, Consistency: 8/20, Function Security: 5/20
context.suggested_fix: Apply comprehensive fix migration 20260108000002_comprehensive_rls_fix.sql

issues.title: Re-Enable RLS on All Golf Tables

context.suggested_fix: Use ical-generator library instead of manual string building

issues.title: Add Database Indexes for Discovery Page
issues.description: Player discovery with filters (position, grad year, state, velocity) is slow (2-3s) due to missing indexes. Would be 80% faster with proper indexing.

context.suggested_fix: Add indexes on recruiting_activated, primary_position, grad_year, state, throwing_velocity, exit_velocity

issues.title: Large Watchlists Render Slowly
issues.description: Watchlist table renders all rows at once. With 100+ prospects, the page becomes sluggish with janky scrolling and slow search due to DOM thrashing.

context.root_cause: No virtual scrolling, 100+ DOM nodes cause layout thrashing
context.suggested_fix: Implement virtual scrolling with react-virtual or react-window

issues.title: Conversation Participants RLS History Unstable
issues.description: Migration 078 DISABLED RLS on conversation_participants with comment 'Nuclear Option: Drop ALL Policies'. While migration 20260108000001 re-enabled it, history shows system couldn't maintain stable RLS without recursion issues.

context.monitor_for: Postgres errors containing 'infinite recursion', message send failures
context.suggested_fix: Monitor for recursion errors, consider simplifying policy logic further

issues.title: Permissive Conversation Creation
issues.description: Policy 'Users can create conversations' uses WITH CHECK (true), allowing ANY authenticated user to create conversations without validation. Combined with SECURITY DEFINER function, enables phishing and impersonation attacks.

context.attack_scenario: Attacker creates conversation with arbitrary users, injects messages appearing to be from coach
context.suggested_fix: Add team/sport validation in WITH CHECK clause and application layer

issues.title: Complex SECURITY DEFINER Functions
issues.description: 18 SECURITY DEFINER functions bypass RLS with complex authorization logic. Functions are difficult to audit and may contain logic errors enabling cross-team or cross-sport data access.

context.suggested_fix: Add comprehensive logging, input validation, replace with RLS policies where possible

issues.title: Permissive Policies Using USING (true)
issues.description: Multiple tables use USING (true) or WITH CHECK (true) making data completely public to authenticated users. Exposes coach contact info, invite codes, allows notification spam, exposes AI patterns and ML models.

context.suggested_fix: Replace all USING (true) with proper scoping based on team/role

issues.title: Coaches Can View All Players (Baseball)
issues.description: Policy 'Coaches can view all players' allows ANY user with role='coach' to see ALL player profiles regardless of recruiting_activated status or commitment. NCAA violation risk for viewing committed players.

context.vulnerability_type: Privacy violation, NCAA recruiting rules violation
context.attack_scenario: Coach from School A views players committed to School B, gets contact info
context.suggested_fix: Drop 'Coaches can view all players' policy, keep only recruiting-scoped policy

issues.title: Coach Contact Information Fully Public
issues.description: coaches table has policy 'Anyone can view coach profiles' with USING (true), exposing ALL coach emails, phones, and personal info to ANY authenticated user.

context.attack_scenario: SELECT email_contact, phone FROM coaches harvests ALL coach contact info
context.privacy_impact: GDPR violation, enables spam and phishing
context.suggested_fix: Replace USING (true) with recruiting-scoped policy: coaches visible only to recruiting-activated players and other coaches

issues.title: Golf Coach Notes Privacy Violation
issues.description: golf_coach_notes table has RLS enabled but NO POLICIES. Depending on defaults, players may be able to see coach's private notes (shared_with_player = false) containing honest assessments.

context.attack_scenario: Player queries private coach notes: 'Player has attitude problems, not starter material'
context.legal_risk: Defamation liability if harsh notes exposed
context.suggested_fix: Add policies: coaches view own notes, players view only shared_with_player = true notes

issues.title: Team Invitation Code Enumeration
issues.description: team_invitations policy 'Active invitations viewable by code' uses USING (is_active = TRUE), allowing ANY authenticated user to enumerate ALL active invite codes and brute force team access.

context.attack_scenario: SELECT invite_code FROM team_invitations WHERE is_active = true returns ALL codes
context.suggested_fix: Restrict to exact code match with parameterized query, enforce at application layer

issues.title: Golf Global Patterns IP Theft
issues.description: golf_global_patterns table has policy 'Authenticated can read global patterns' with USING (true), exposing ALL analytics data and AI patterns to ANY authenticated user, enabling IP theft.

context.attack_scenario: Competitor exports ALL pattern_type, conditions, outcome, average_impact to reverse engineer CoachHelm AI
context.business_impact: Loss of competitive moat, R&D investment wasted
context.suggested_fix: Restrict to golf users only: USING (auth.uid() IN (SELECT user_id FROM golf_players UNION SELECT user_id FROM golf_coaches))

issues.title: Notification Spam Attack Vector
issues.description: golf_calendar_notifications has INSERT policy with WITH CHECK (true), allowing ANY authenticated user to create notifications for ANY user, enabling spam and phishing campaigns.

context.attack_scenario: INSERT INTO golf_calendar_notifications (user_id, message) with phishing link sent to 10k users
context.suggested_fix: Restrict to user_id = auth.uid() OR coach creating notifications for team members

issues.title: Fix Permissive Policies
